text:
A pendulum bob swings from W, through points X and Y, to Z and then back to W.
Z
W
X
Y
Which statement is correct?
A
The gravitational potential energy of the bob is smallest at W.
B
The gravitational potential energy of the bob is smallest at X.
C
The gravitational potential energy of the bob is smallest at Y.
D
The gravitational potential energy of the bob is the same at all points of the swing.
